Java navigation for Mayoi, with a native Go setup tool and Eclipse JDT Language Server.

- Run JDT LS directly through Mayoi's native language server client, with no resident Python proxy.
- Preserve workspace aliases for navigation through symlinked repositories.
- Check setup from the Plugins menu and install a checksum-verified Lombok agent.
- Keep auto-build and annotation-processing compatibility options per workspace.

## Downloads

Each archive contains the tool, `plugin.json`, `main.ts`, `LICENSE` and `README.md`.

## Install

Requires a Mayoi build containing [PR #135](https://github.com/sorrycc/Mayoi/pull/135), JDK 25+ and Eclipse JDT LS. Mayoi releases without `contributes.languageServers[].resolve` cannot load this plugin. Python, Node and a Go compiler are not runtime dependencies.

Download your archive and `SHA256SUMS` into an empty folder. For macOS Apple Silicon:

```sh
grep '  mayoi-java_v0.3.0_darwin_arm64.tar.gz$' SHA256SUMS | shasum -a 256 -c -
tar -xzf mayoi-java_v0.3.0_darwin_arm64.tar.gz
mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
install -m 755 mayoi-java "$HOME/.local/bin/mayoi-java"
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
mayoi plugin install Adrian-Zephyr-Liao/mayoi-java@v0.3.0
mayoi-java setup
mayoi-java version
```

For Linux, select the corresponding archive and verify its checksum with `sha256sum -c`. For Windows, verify the ZIP with `Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256`, extract it, and put `mayoi-java.exe` on PATH before running the plugin install and setup commands. Add the tool directory to your shell's PATH for future terminals. A GUI app with a minimal PATH can set the plugin's `helperPath` to the executable's absolute path.

The tool prepares a launch description and exits; Java runs as a direct child of Mayoi. Startup performs no downloads. `setup` installs the separately versioned Lombok agent after checking its pinned SHA-256 checksum; JDK and JDT LS installation remain explicit.
